purpose: Additive controlling supplement for local WU-05 repair. It supersedes defective v1/v2 repair gates without modifying historical package files.

authority.exact_package_sha_binding: external K0_PACKAGE_SHA from PR #21, Jira PM-7, Confluence 15499267, and delivered publication receipt

supersedes_for_wu05_closure: FRESH_REVIEW_REPAIR_AUTHORITY.json v1 clauses that permit self-reported bridge evidence
verify-k0-fresh-review-repair.py token-only signed-residual and weak evidence checks

observed_failure_modes.failure: active repair files omitted from PACKAGE_MANIFEST while package validation passes
observed_failure_modes.guard: supplement manifest plus exact active-file-set check

observed_failure_modes.failure: moving package branch is merged without exact external SHA pin
public bridge receipt is self-reported rather than derived from Rust source
observed_failure_modes.guard: source-derived bridge inventory and call-site scan

observed_failure_modes.failure: signed-residual guard name is present but test was not executed
observed_failure_modes.guard: targeted cargo execution with exactly one passing test

observed_failure_modes.failure: arbitrary hard-gate map or fabricated numerical digest passes
observed_failure_modes.guard: raw-derived exact gate set and canonical payload recomputation

observed_failure_modes.failure: failure work preservation is only an unchecked boolean
observed_failure_modes.guard: partial stage count and canonical digest equality

review_policy: No new review layer. Reuse the single fresh repair review and final differential audit; v3 replaces weak gates rather than adding meta-review.
validator_transparency: Run python tools/verify-k0-wu05-supplement.py --dump-source to inspect the exact UTF-8 validator source; the manifest binds both loader and compressed payload.
